leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Vue component hierarchy with three levels of nested components
Initialize and pass primitive data types as props from parent to child components
Configure prop validation rules for type checking in child components
Manipulate and display received props within nested component templates
Update parent component data and observe prop changes flow through the hierarchy
Bind dynamic values as props using v-bind directives
Apply props drilling patterns to share state across multiple component levels
